title: Case 049: Acquiring Report Ready
initial_request: I need the acquiring report for 1–7 July 2025 to review the card sales and adjustments for my shop.
overview: Mara Venn selected the reporting period in H&V’s secure portal, then escalated when the report file was not yet available. After checking her authority, the agent asked H&V’s acquiring service to place the report for her. The secure portal subsequently showed the report as available. That status confirms report availability, not receipt of the sales proceeds.

next_action.summary: The agent’s immediate action was to ask H&V’s acquiring service to prepare and place the report for the selected period for the authorised manager.

outcome: The portal showed the report for 1–7 July 2025 as available, with a report total of £236.00. This does not establish that any funds were credited.

events.body: I selected 1–7 July 2025 for North Quay Printworks’ acquiring report. I need the file to review the card sales and adjustments.
I’m the authorised manager for the shop. The report for the period I selected is not showing as available, so I’m asking you to escalate the file request.
I checked the manager’s authority for this business. Please prepare and place the acquiring report for 1–7 July 2025 in the secure portal for the authorised user.
I placed the report for 1–7 July 2025 in the secure portal. Its report total is £236.00; placement confirms report availability only, not a settlement credit.

Report status: Available. File: merchant-report-049.csv. Period: 1–7 July 2025; card sales: £240.00; adjustments: -£4.00; report total: £236.00. Availability does not confirm that funds were credited.
